sections.title: Hypothetico-deductive reasoning, falsification and Popper's account

missing_pieces.duty: MP-0(b)/US-0: reconstruct from the held Popper2002 text (Routledge Classics, electronic issue 2005) the probability material that the owned body says it does not reconstruct. This covers the second B1/B2 model matrices of appendix *iv (inductive-logic-and-confirmation-w02b-p15-027.tex:1395-1398), the four-element system S', the Borel-field extension and the improved BD/CD of the appendix *iv addendum (lines 1413-1415), the derivations of appendix *v (line 1415), appendix *ix (lines 1574-1575) and appendices *vii-*xii beyond the points used (lines 2003-2006). Each needs its actual definitions, statements, proofs and later-note/addendum distinctions.
